Corran Horn has enjoyed a broad range of careers. He has been a police officer, a soldier, a spy, and a Jedi, giving him a diverse skill set that makes him dangerous on many battlefields. He can serve as a mentor for Jedi pilots, a contact for information, or an advisor for particularly delicate missions. The PCs might be assigned to accompany Corran to troubled worlds and complete missions under his supervision to help stabilize the situation.
